renderer.fontPolicy: Renderer only: digest-verified vendored Inter 4.1; fontconfig maps -apple-system, system-ui and sans-serif to Inter. Production font stacks stay intact. Body computed family and resolved Inter, painted font families, and all quote-profile faces are guarded before captures and comparisons. Full JetBrains Mono is reserved for mono text; profile documents use their Source Sans 3 / Source Serif 4 Display faces.
renderer.containerPolicy: Visual = CI only. Container digest, Chromium build, font SHA-256 and fontconfig file SHA-256 determine renderer identity. Hosted ImageOS/ImageVersion are diagnostic metadata. Change the container digest only with regenerated baseline evidence and a reviewed manifest in the same PR; never via an automated bump.

comparison.justification: No pixel tolerance: the same digest-pinned Playwright container, bundled browser, fontconfig file, scale, emulation and vendored glyphs must render identically. Zero tolerance requires two byte-identical captures of the same commit before pinning.

capture.writes: Only Playwright testInfo.outputPath() captures and the run artifact under web/test-results; never reference paths, tickets, releases or Git.
